independent_checks.pair_code_standard: Verified source in evidence is verbatim UniswapV2Pair fork (error strings 'Sharkswap: *'; mint/burn/swap/skim/sync/permit only; no extra privileged functions). skim() is stock and would transfer balance-reserve excess to any caller-chosen address, but excess = 0 wei everywhere.

corrections_to_claim: Aggregate '96.2% of LP burned at dormant EOA' not reproduced: by current USD-weighting (DefiLlama prices) dormant share is ~85%; using prior ownership.json totals it is ~90.9% ($124,294/$136,751); per-pool figures are exact (99.9895% / 98.2316%). Valuation-dependent, not material to extractability.

TOP is not literally unpriced/untraded: it has nominal listings (Maverick/iziswap/UniV4/Curve; GeckoTerminal quotes), but all on-chain sellable liquidity is dust (largest-looking venue holds 4 wei USDC), so the '$0 drain' conclusion stands while the stated reason is imprecise.
limitations: Unused pre-signed EIP-712 permite signatures are unobservable on-chain; if the dormant key was NOT destroyed, a valid permit could still move its LP. No evidence of any; normal burn assumption applies.
